title: A wonderful experience and beautiful memories
text: I had a wonderful photoshoot with Cristina! She is warm, friendly and genuinely passionate about her work, taking the time to make the experience special without ever making you feel rushed. Her enthusiasm and lovely personality made it much more than just a photoshoot. It was a truly memorable experience that I will cherish, and I sincerely hope our paths cross again soon!

title: Preserve your memories in photos!
text: Cris was an amazing photographer that was able to capture the memories that we wanted! It was so nice to be able to not have to try to find a stranger take pictures for us on a trip like this! She made us feel at home and kept us laughing! You will not regret spending money on preserving these memories.

title: Awesome and beautiful photos by a true artist!
text: Our photographer Cris was excellent. We were a large family group with people of varied ages. author: alejandrogT167SR

title: Great company, great shots
text: Cristina was great! Our time with her went very well and our pictures came out amazing. We chose to do an early (9am) shoot which worked out well as the lighting was great all around the Sagrada Familia. You can tell she knows the best spots to get a great picture and while much of the spots had construction objects in the way she was able to pivot quickly all while guiding us on how to pose. Definitely a must try if you are in Barcelona and have an hour to spare for some quality shots.
